# Selected-organism source observations

This package records original VisibleWorld callbacks with actual paused MainWindow, VisibleWorld, and InfoToolbar collaborators.
It contains no Rust comparison result.

The helper calls the seven original StdAction instances on the Swing event dispatch thread.
It does not reproduce their guards, energy arithmetic, revive assignments, or reproduction implementation.
Original World.findOrganismFromPosition supplies pick results.
Two original World.time calls continue the real callback state.

PlayerActionsOracle.java remains frozen at 5678870b.
The capture driver remains frozen at aa68ea8d.
Root authorization dc803f42 and independent preparation review e32842f1 cover those exact files.
The captured helper classes match across unchanged source and bundled JAR compilations.

## Observed branch outcomes

Forced reproduction creates one actual child in the success case.
The blocked attempt creates no child and retains the actual saved g5 genotype.
After the supplied blocker moves and the tree rebuilds, retry creates the g5 child and clears the saved reference.
The full data preserves source RNG draws, energy changes, parent context, membership, and event order.

A coherent zero-gene body pastes successfully and joins the original World.
Actual Kill makes it dead and reduces population to zero.
Actual Revive restores alive, active, age1, and population1 while retaining energy40.
This valid source outcome is not classified as an unsupported empty-genome boundary.

Five revive cases preserve every original field and holder before and after the callback.
revive-field-deltas.json records actual changed and retained fields without computing source reset formulas.
The cases cover mixed PURPLE physiology, EYE classification, spore5 age1, BLOND/FLOWER, and GOLD maximum-age wrapping.
Controlled retained-state flags and caches remain supplied inputs rather than natural-play claims.

The null-gene-color diagnostic throws an actual NullPointerException during original Revive.
It has already set alive, active, and age1 before failing.
Population remains unchanged after its earlier death decrement.
The nullable phenotype and partial source reset remain explicitly unrepresented by current typed Rust preflight rejection.

The nonempty-body/empty-code diagnostic throws an actual ArithmeticException before revive state resets.
Its victim remains dead after the failed callback.
Source exception class and message remain preserved observations, not Rust error-class equivalence claims.
